label: Slate interface-theme background tile
derivation: lossless PNG re-encode during transfer; pixels identical to the supplied 64-by-64 image
presentation_contract: Repeated in both axes without stretching behind menu-style screens when a Slate interface theme is selected, under the theme's dimming colour and an edge vignette. Also laid faintly, at the player's panel-texture strength (10% by default), over framed panels and the play screen's own surfaces in both HUD layouts.
